exam.title: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: AI Infrastructure and Operations
exam.study_prerequisites: NVIDIA lists basic data-center infrastructure knowledge. Build workload-to-stack reasoning across AI/ML/DL, CPU/GPU and training/inference; size compute, memory, topology, network, storage, power and cooling; then practice supported lifecycle, scheduling/orchestration, GPU telemetry, safe diagnosis and sharing/virtualization decisions.

review.notes: Every public objective is mapped through workload requirements, compute/memory/topology, network/storage/facility sizing, supported software, scheduling/orchestration, telemetry, safe diagnosis and sharing/virtualization evidence. Three scenarios, eight authorized labs and 40 checks are included. Seven URLs are reachable and Udemy is automation-blocked; none are broken. The USD 125 certification page versus USD 135 learning-path card discrepancy is explicit. No recalled/live item, dump, unsafe production instruction or copied course content is used.

findings.title: Related fields can use different types and scales

findings.title: An Xid code is not an incident counter
findings.evidence: Field gauge and exporter window/cumulative sampled-record families differ.
findings.recommendation: Explain semantics,reset and cadence before deriving rates or counts.
findings.resolution: Explain semantics,reset and cadence before deriving rates or counts.

findings.title: Replica allocation does not imply isolation or proportional compute
findings.evidence: Time-slicing limitations include shared memory/fault domains and no container metric association in the documented path.
findings.recommendation: Separate replica count from physical capacity and require workload/isolation evidence.
findings.resolution: Separate replica count from physical capacity and require workload/isolation evidence.

findings.title: Compute instances share parent GPU-instance memory
findings.evidence: Multiple CIs in one GI share its memory and engines.
findings.recommendation: Deduplicate memory by GI identity and keep parent physical totals separate.
findings.resolution: Deduplicate memory by GI identity and keep parent physical totals separate.

findings.title: Successful upgrade steps need workload-specific validation
findings.evidence: 26.7.1 notes operand readiness fix and H100 driver-transition MIG issue;26.7.0 DRA route has separate prerequisites.
findings.recommendation: Teach exact-route/version acceptance and authorized recovery instead of universal upgrade recipes.
findings.resolution: Teach exact-route/version acceptance and authorized recovery instead of universal upgrade recipes.

findings.title: Storage growth is more than adding capacity
findings.evidence: Historical article distinguishes throughput,capacity and maintenance availability.
findings.recommendation: Add original concurrent checkpoint payload budget and require measured restore evidence.
findings.resolution: Add original concurrent checkpoint payload budget and require measured restore evidence.

Compare and contrast GPU and CPU architectures.
